A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E2 in the lower border (3 July 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-PC-Errata-2023-07-D-E2-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Commence Recharging (PC 2023-02 D-E2 card)]] (20 February 2023): The game text changes: “planet,” becomes “system,”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E2” in the lower border.

The whole 2023-02 D-E2 card image and the whole 2023-07 D-E2 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
